info.name: Capture a URL screenshot or PDF

params.name: url
params.description: Absolute http or https URL to capture. Public or authorized URLs only.

params.name: width
params.description: Viewport width in pixels. Maximum 1920.

params.name: height
params.description: Viewport height in pixels. Maximum 10000.

params.name: fullPage
params.description: Capture the full scrollable page.

params.name: type
params.description: Output format.

params.name: quality
params.description: JPEG/WebP quality from 1 to 100.

params.name: colorScheme
params.description: Force light or dark color-scheme rendering.

params.name: waitUntil
params.description: Navigation lifecycle event to wait for before capture.

params.name: waitForSelector
params.description: CSS selector to wait for before capture.

params.name: delay
params.description: Additional delay in milliseconds after the page loads.

params.name: blockAds
params.description: Block common ad and tracker requests during capture.

params.name: removeCookieBanners
params.description: Hide and accept common cookie banners before capture.

params.name: cssInject
params.description: CSS to inject before capture. Maximum 10000 characters.

params.name: jsInject
params.description: JavaScript to evaluate before capture. Maximum 10000 characters.

params.name: stealthMode
params.description: Use stealth rendering for authorized targets.

params.name: devicePixelRatio
params.description: Retina/HiDPI capture scale.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone to emulate, such as America/New_York.

params.name: locale
params.description: BCP 47 locale to emulate, such as en-US.

params.name: cacheTtl
params.description: Response cache TTL in seconds. Maximum 604800.

params.name: preloadFonts
params.description: Preload discovered Google Fonts before capture.

params.name: removeElements
params.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors to remove before capture.

params.name: removePopups
params.description: Remove common popups, modals, and overlays.

params.name: mockupDevice
params.description: Wrap the screenshot in a device frame.

params.name: geoLatitude
params.description: Latitude for browser geolocation override.

params.name: geoLongitude
params.description: Longitude for browser geolocation override.

params.name: geoAccuracy
params.description: Geolocation accuracy in meters.

items.docs: Capture a public or authorized URL as PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF. This endpoint returns binary image/PDF data directly.
Capture raw HTML or a URL as PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF. Use POST when sending HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or larger structured options.
